 Full injury reports for Sixers-Cavaliers on Thursday
 The Sixers have already been hit with a slew of frontcourt injuries.
 By 
 Adam Aaronson
 PhillyVoice Staff
 Sixers 
 NBA 
 Colleen Claggett/for PhillyVoice
 Will Dean Wade make his Sixers debut against his former team on Thursday? 
 Read More 
 Dean Wade (ankle) is questionable to make his Sixers debut against his former team when the Cleveland Cavaliers come to Philadelphia on Thursday night, according to the Sixers' initial injury report for the game unveiled on Wednesday:
 The Sixers have an injury report for tomorrow's game vs. Cleveland:
Dean Wade – ankle – QUESTIONABLE
Dominick Barlow – back – OUT
Tacko Fall – quad – OUT
— Adam Aaronson (@SixersAdam) October 21, 2026 
 Wade, whose injury occurred during last week's preseason finale, missed Tuesday's season opener alongside Dominick Barlow (back) and Tacko Fall (quad).
 For Cleveland, starting center Jarrett Allen is questionable due to right patellar t endinopathy . Deeper reserves Nae'Qwon Tomline and Khalifa Diop are out.
